capability.name: A2A Agent Card check: well-formed, and do its JWS signatures verify
capability.description: Reads an A2A Agent Card (https://<domain>/.well-known/agent-card.json, the pre-1.0 agent.json, any https URL, or the card itself) and checks it against the A2A 1.0 specification: required fields, interfaces (https, known binding, preferred first, on the card's host or not), skills and declared security. Then verifies each JWS signature (RFC 7515, detached) over the card without signatures in RFC 8785 form: header (alg allowed, kid, no crit), key by kid from the keys you give or the JWKS at jku on the card's host (or a jwks URL you name), and ES256, ES384, EdDSA, RS256-512 or PS256-512. Signers prepare the card as served, with empty values removed (a2a-python) or with defaults removed; the answer says which form the signature covers. Verdict signed_verified, signature_failed, unsigned, malformed or not_found.

url.description: a domain, or the card's https URL

card.description: or the card itself, checked offline

jwks.description: a JWKS https URL to read when jku is on another host

algorithms.description: accepted JWS algorithms (default: all asymmetric ones listed)

note: before you call an A2A agent: is its card what its key holder signed
